title: Pickleball Players Quadrupled In Just Four Years
hook: Pickleball looks harmless. Its injuries now cost Americans hundreds of millions.
closing: Grab a paddle. Everyone else already did.
question: Have you played pickleball yet?

segments.say: In 2019, about 3.3 million Americans played pickleball. By 2023, that was over four times as many.
Tennis still has more players, about 23.6 million. But pickleball is already past halfway to catching it.
Pickleball injuries are estimated to cost about 400 million dollars in 2023. That's nearly triple 2018, so fun has a real price.
